request.system: Assess whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests numbered claims. Return JSON only: {"uses_claim": true|false, "claim_ids": []}. Return one bare JSON object without Markdown fences or commentary. uses_claim must be a JSON boolean. claim_ids must be an array of integer claim numbers, never quoted strings; use an empty array when uses_claim is false.
request.prompt: {"claims": {"1": "**Findings so far**", "2": "Our first attempt combined three-month momentum in average hours and in hourly pay as a rank product.", "3": "It failed.", "4": "Its next-month predictive correlation was slightly negative, insignificant and unchanged across common-index regimes.", "5": "The second attempt favored groups whose V02 flow rate rose faster than V03 over three months.", "6": "It produced a meaningfully negative correlation, with a t-statistic near minus two, concentrated when the common index was low.", "7": "Reversing its direction, perhaps conditioned on the low regime, looks promising.", "8": "Both features showed low overlap with base signals and moderate rank persistence."}, "hypothesis": "Relative shifts from V02 toward V03 flow predict higher next-month relative returns mainly when the common index is low. Restricting the signal to low-T regimes should strengthen its information coefficient versus the unconditional version.", "expression": "regime(spread(chg(V03,3),chg(V02,3)),\"low\")"}
